users.title: Users
users.intro: People with access to the platform at this school.
users.caption: School users

empty.title: There are no users yet
empty.text: Add the first one to get started.

errors.unexpected: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.tooManyRequestsWithSeconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.

detail.title: Profile
detail.selfNote: You cannot change your own account from here.

deactivate.title: Deactivate {name}
deactivate.description: They will not be able to sign in until you activate the account again.

delete.title: Remove {name}
delete.description: The account stops being available and cannot sign in. You can restore it later.

invite.title: Send an invitation to {name}
invite.description: An activation link will be sent to {email}. The previous invitation, if any, will stop working.

removeRoles.title: Remove roles from {name}
removeRoles.description: These roles will be removed: {roles}. They will lose the permissions those roles granted.

flash.restored: User restored. The account is inactive: activate it if they need to sign in again.
flash.createdInvited: User created and invitation sent. It expires on {date}.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.intro: Activation links sent to pending users.
invitations.caption: School invitations

empty.title: There are no invitations
empty.text: Invitations appear here when you add a user or resend their link.

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation of {email}
revoke.description: The link that was sent will stop working.

reissue.title: Resend the invitation to {email}
reissue.description: A new link will be sent and the previous one will stop working.

flash.reissued: Invitation sent to {email}. It expires on {date}.

userImports.title: User import
userImports.intro: Upload a CSV file to create users in bulk. It is validated first: nothing is created until you run the batch.
userImports.caption: User import batches

empty.title: No imports
empty.text: Batches appear here once you upload a file.

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.fileHint: CSV format (.csv) in UTF-8, with “;” or “,” as separator, up to 10 MB.
upload.sendInvitations: Send invitations to the imported users

errors.extension: The file must have the .csv extension.
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.

header.title: Exact header expected
header.hint: The first row of the file must be exactly this one, with the columns in this order.
header.manual: The details of each column are in the administration manual, section “User import”.

documentTypes.title: Supported document types
documentTypes.hint: In the document_type column, write one of these codes; upper or lower case does not matter. If you give the type you must also give the number, and the other way round.

detail.title: Import {file}
detail.stalled: The batch is not moving forward. The import process may not be running.
detail.truncated: Issues shown: {shown}. Rows with errors in total: {total}. Download the full report to see them all.

headerFailed.title: The file header is not valid

execute.title: Run the import of {file}
execute.invitationsYes: Invitations will be sent to the users created.

discard.title: Discard the import of {file}
discard.description: The uploaded file and the report will be deleted. No user has been created.

flash.executing: Import under way. The status updates by itself.
